page_title: PAL 2-2 ALA | Las Palmas v Alaves 14/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) is punished with the yellow card.
90+9' Mario Melero shows the yellow card to Asier Villalibre (Alaves) for a heavy challenge.
90+7' Although Diego Martinez (Las Palmas) is just on the bench, Mario Melero has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+6' Having seen unsporting behavior, Mario Melero shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Eduardo Coudet (Alaves) is the recipient.

90+5' 2 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Adrian Rodriguez, so the score changes to 2:2.
90+3' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) picks up a caution.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 2 Goal! Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Adrian Rodriguez into the bottom left corner.
90' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

89' The referee blows his whistle after Facundo Garces (Alaves) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. That's a penalty to Las Palmas! They have a good chance to score now.
84' Jon Guridi (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Mario Melero blows for a foul.
83' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
83' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Campana leaves the pitch and Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) comes on.
80' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
78' Mario Melero blows his whistle. Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) commits a foul after dangerous play.
77' The attendance for today's match is 17566.
77' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Carlos Martin and he is replaced by Facundo Garces (Alaves).
76' Substitution. Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) has come on for Joan Jordan.
76' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Mario Melero signals a set piece.
74' Wow, what an escape. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
71' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch so that Sandro Ramirez can be given a rest.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Asier Villalibre (Alaves) is adjudged offside.

65' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mario Melero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
63' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' 0 - 2 Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball in the middle of the goal.
61' Here is a change. Carlos Vicente is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Jon Guridi (Alaves).
60' Toni Martinez is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
60' The game has come to an end for Alex Suarez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marvin (Las Palmas).
57' Mario Melero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) and blew his whistle.
56' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
52' Joan Jordan (Alaves) will take the corner.
49' The foul by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mario Melero.
48' Golden chance! Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
46' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Alex Munoz is replaced by Mika Marmol (Las Palmas).
46' It's time for a substitution. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) comes on in place of Stefan Bajcetic.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+1' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Toni Martinez (Alaves) for a tough tackle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
44' Ander Guevara (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
43' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) heads on.
41' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
41' Toni Martinez (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Joan Jordan (Alaves) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
38' Carles Alena (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
36' Ander Guevara (Alaves) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Las Palmas win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
34' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian Rodriguez is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
27' Mario Melero blows the whistle, Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul.
26' Toni Martinez (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
23' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mario Melero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' A goal, which was scored by Toni Martinez (Alaves), was disallowed due to offside.
21' Alaves force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Toni Martinez (Alaves) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!

17' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Adrian Rodriguez. This effort really didn't trouble him.
16' Dangerous play by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves). Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
11' Carlos Martin (Alaves) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen makes a comfortable save.
7' 0 - 1 Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
5' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
4' Today's referee Mario Melero rightly decides to book Joan Jordan (Alaves) for his harsh tackle.
2' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
Mario Melero will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
